summary: SCNet (超算互联网) runs a MaaS special-offer campaign from 2026-08-13 00:00 to 2026-11-10 23:59. Accounts first registered on SCNet during the campaign can claim a free 10,000,000-token GLM-5.3-Flash pack (1024K context) once per account; it is credited immediately and valid for 30 days. Total supply is limited, first come first served. The granted model may be changed to another specification based on supply. Gifted tokens are used first; after they run out, the cash balance is charged automatically, so stop before the gift is used up to avoid charges.
claim_steps: Register a new SCNet account during the campaign period.
On the MaaS campaign page, click 免费领取 (claim for free) on the 10,000,000-token new-user pack; tokens are credited immediately.
Use the tokens within 30 days; stop before they run out to avoid cash-balance charges.
